subject: Meridian Fabrication: outstanding items
body:
[Note for Sarah, delete before sending: the ledger lists the Q1 2025 covenant compliance package (first requested 2025-03-14) as outstanding but also marks it "delivered on time." It is left out below. Please check and add it back if it is still outstanding.]

Hi David,

I'm following up on several items we are still waiting for on our side:

1. Updated 12-month cash flow projections, with assumptions stated (first requested 10 April 2024)
2. Purchase order documentation for the aerospace contract (first requested 23 January 2025)
3. Customer names on the 60-90 day accounts receivable balances (first requested 31 January 2025)

Could you let me know by the end of this week a date when we can expect these? If something is holding any of them up, I'm happy to set up a short call to talk it through and find a way forward.

Thanks, David. I appreciate your help getting these across.

Best regards,
Sarah
